sections.Profile:
The "Moon Shot" pinball machine, released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in February 1963, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game with a space exploration theme. Designed by Ted Zale, it features two flippers, four pop bumpers, two slingshots, and four standup targets.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1963
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Space, Original Theme, Single level playfield
